goal: Enhance the existing service: let link owners extend the expiry of an existing short link and show the remaining time in the stats response.

functional.text: Expose click analytics per short link
acceptance: GET /api/urls/{code}/stats returns total clicks, last access and a daily breakdown
Recording clicks never slows down redirects
A link created with expiresInMinutes stops redirecting after that time (410)
Out-of-range expiry values are rejected with 400

functional.text: Allow the link owner to extend the expiry of an existing link
acceptance: PUT /api/urls/{code}/expiry moves the expiry forward for the owner
Non-owners receive 403; unknown codes 404; deactivated links 410
Stats expose the remaining time until expiry

assumptions: No end-user authentication in this iteration: clients are identified by the X-Client-Id header or IP (spoofable).
Single-instance deployment with in-memory storage behind a repository abstraction.
Existing public API contracts stay backward compatible.
